summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute a bundled 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from oven-sh's GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmods it executable, and immediately invokes it against a bundled sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line blob using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (push/shift), `_0x`-renamed identifiers, and a custom charset base decoder — with no accompanying source, README explanation, or build recipe. Fetching an alternate language runtime at install time solely to execute an opaque author-controlled payload that Node-based review tools cannot reach is the alternate-runtime-dropper structural shape. The runtime origin (oven-sh) is legitimate, but the executed content is the shipped obfuscated blob, not documented package functionality, and it fires automatically on `npm install` before any consent point.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
